exact_consumption.positive_mass: omega=I00+I01=integral w dr. Intersect only with Delta_r*w enclosure of the same integral, not with a different candidate residual.
exact_consumption.original_mean: For each new true leaf take the maximum of the already certified complete mean root bounds on all intersecting old source leaves; verify those leaves cover it.
exact_consumption.mean_derivative_units: Old c_x is divided by certified r_x>0; PA/CF use physical r. The new delta-c bound improves the mean contribution to h_r and the w_r delta-c term in h_rr. The actual c_r difference remains bounded by the sum of the original two complete derivative bounds.
exact_consumption.mean_constant: Fix one common left height. All cumulative differences thereafter remain one signed integral, enclosed symmetrically; the final shift persists through unchanged later pieces.
exact_consumption.six_jets: For PA/CF retain h,h_r,h_rr,h_theta,h_rtheta,h_thetatheta, all nonmean modes, full c and c_r. For old->new retain only the valid saved complete mean-height/derivative bounds; do not infer missing old H from J.
exact_consumption.scope_limit: No new exact outer solution, spatial immersion, held ratio, reach, automatic replacement, or signed mean cancellation is claimed.
exact_consumption.paired_root_scope: Only PA/CF at the same source leaf and same true r,w, with all H/Kbar/Kbar_r modes stored. Old candidate comparisons remain the certified original complete-mean absolute bounds.
exact_consumption.real_line: Interpolate the entire real state (c,Kbar,P,T) between the two exact complete roots. Intermediate states need not be roots. A and D are concave along that line, L is affine, so endpoint true lower bounds prove the whole line remains in the real positive domain.
exact_consumption.zero_modes: Subtract exactly 1 from B_K and B_T using zero means of delta Kbar and delta T. All frequency multipliers m and m^2 are paid from full saved H coefficient differences.
exact_consumption.coefficients: Use theorem M.12--M.14 with exact Fraction arithmetic, E*=1+w_max^2, A_min, D0=min(1,D_min), L_min and full real Fourier absolute sums. Take min of this root-difference bound and the original sum only because both bound the same PA/CF root difference.
